messages:
miriam: FYI escalated from Acme — after last night's routeflip their integration stopped invoking our billing-check tool. They say it used to trigger on charge events, now it's absent.

sara: Can you paste the webhook payload they send? Also need trace_id and model variant if available.

miriam: Copying the customer's example payload and repro. They included trace id trace-abc123. HTTP POST body:

```json
{
  "event": "charge.succeeded",
  "amount": 1200,
  "metadata": {"customer_id":"acme-47"},
  "model_request": {
    "input": "Generate invoice and call billing_check",
    "tools": ["billing_check"],
    "session_id": "s-99"
  }
}
```

miriam: Expected model to emit a tool call like {"tool":"billing_check","args":{"customer_id":"acme-47"}} but received model output with no tool_calls array — only plain text.

ryan: Can you grab the router logs for trace-abc123? I want to see which variant handled it.

deploy-bot: routeflip completed: new-default -> low-latency-v2 at 2024-08-05T02:11:23Z

ophelia: I pulled the trace. Router routed to low-latency-v2. Model_response for trace-abc123:

```json
{
  "text": "Invoice generated: ID inv_2024_...",
  "tool_calls": []
}
```

ophelia: Weirdly, previous variant (stable-v1) returned tool_calls with payload. Looking at model-side logs, the inference runtime passed a 'tool_mask' header set to 0 for that session when routed to low-latency-v2.

sara: Could the optimizer pass be stripping tool invocation tokens or tokenization differences? Any recent changes to token mapping in low-latency-v2?

ryan: We did push a micro-optimizer to reduce token emissions (strip delimiters) — commit abcdef — around the same time. It might have removed the function call prefix token pattern the model relied on.

miriam: Customer repro steps attached in ticket. They said a canary earlier worked, but full routeflip coincided with break.

ophelia: Quick repro I ran locally against low-latency-v2:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REPRO_KEY" \
  -d '{"input":"Charge succeeded. Call billing_check(customer_id=\"acme-47\")","tools":["billing_check"]}'
```

ophelia: Response: no tool_calls. Against stable-v1 same payload returns tool_calls with correct args.

ryan: Next steps: revert micro-optimizer from low-latency-v2 in prod canary, re-run small subset of traffic to confirm. Also add explicit test in infra-e2e that checks function-call token sequence is preserved.

miriam: Customer asking for ETA — they're blocked in production workflows. Any temporary workaround? Maybe force route to stable-v1 for their org?

sara: We can add routing rule: if org==acme-47 route to stable-v1. I'll propose in console and escalate to platform to apply.

ophelia: Also pushing a small patch to the tokenizer mapping that restores the function-call prefix. If that passes canary I'll schedule rollout.

ryan: I'll open a rollback PR for the micro-optimizer and tag @eng-oncall. Logging trace and add regression alert.

miriam: Thanks. I'll update the customer with routing workaround and ETA 2-4h for a rollback check.

sara: :thumbsup: keep updates here.
